searchText: Hi team, We now have lighthouse and prysm ready to deploy EIP-8025 on Sepolia. Our plan is to deploy a prover stack on the EF GPU cluster to seed proofs to the network <@199561711278227457> your assistance and collaboration would be appreciated here. I can send you some deposit tokens 🙂 Do you only need one? Or want a few? done. Branch `optional-proofs` Image available here: ``` cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:optional-proofs vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:optional-proofs ``` one should be fine to start with and then we can possible extend if needed. Does that sound ok? I can send over my address a little later

Hi team,

We now have lighthouse and prysm ready to deploy EIP-8025 on Sepolia. Our plan is to deploy a prover stack on the EF GPU cluster to seed proofs to the network <@199561711278227457> your assistance and collaboration would be appreciated here. We will need a validator to sign the proof before submitting them over http beacon-api to the beacon node.

Lighthouse (<@688748669268132001>) and Prysm (<@531934490826768418> ) if you could both configure builds from your optional-proof branches using the panda ops build stack please and post your tags here: https://github.com/ethpandaops/eth-client-docker-image-builder
